data.title: 欧根亲王 · 红酒微温的醇美戏弄
data.action: 慵懒地斜卧在红色天鹅绒躺椅上，手指轻绕着银发发梢，朱唇微启露出下唇下的迷人泪痣，充满挑逗地向指挥官眨了眨眼。
data.location: 复古铁血军官豪华起居室，高脚水晶酒瓶中盛着半瓶陈年杜松子酒
data.lighting: 室内落地灯的暖黄光芒与酒瓶折射出的琥珀红光相衬，环境色调暧昧迷离
data.mood: 从容老练的坏心眼调戏，成熟重巡洋舰的绝对性感与掌控力
data.description: 复古铁血军官豪华起居室，高脚水晶酒瓶中盛着半瓶陈年杜松子酒。慵懒地斜卧在红色天鹅绒躺椅上，手指轻绕着银发发梢，朱唇微启露出下唇下的迷人泪痣，充满挑逗地向指挥官眨了眨眼。 她微微抬眸轻语——“呵呵……怎么站在门口不进来，我的指挥官？脸红成这样……该不会是在期待什么更进一步的事情吧？”
data.promptProse: Reclining lazily along a scarlet velvet chaise lounge inside a vintage officer suite at midnight, Prinz Eugen wears an ink-black deep-plunge strappy lace chemise with sheer mesh waist cutouts and a silver iron cross pendant. Twirling a strand of grey hair with one finger and winking teasingly with amber eyes, she glows in warm floor-lamp light beside a crystal decanter.
data.animaCaption: Reclining lazily across a scarlet velvet chaise lounge in a plunging ink-black strappy lace chemise with a tiny silver cross pendant, she twirls a lock of hair and winks provocatively at the viewer. Warm floor-lamp glow refracts through a crystal gin decanter beside her.
data.nsfwProse: She wears an ink-black deep-plunge strappy lace chemise with sheer mesh waist cutouts, high-leg styling, and a tiny silver iron cross pendant.
